summary: Completed frontend-only testing of Barcode Scanner page. All requested features working correctly: 1) Camera section shows large camera button when available OR 'Camera not available' message with CameraOff icon in headless browser (expected behavior), 2) Manual barcode input functional with proper validation, 3) Barcode lookup API integration working (tested with Coca-Cola 5449000000996), 4) Mobile viewport scrolling works properly, 5) Light/dark theme support verified with proper text contrast.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - minor accessibility improvement opportunity
